24.original: Speak with Alisaie at the Red Serai.

26.original: Speak with Alisaie in the Ocular.

52.original: ...Thank you. What you're doing, it...it means a lot to them. To me.

53.original: ...Sorry to interrupt. We, uh... We realized we hadn't thanked you for rescuing Halric.

54.original: ...You weren't hurt at all, were you?

55.original: Hurt...? There wasn't even a fight. I was too late. Too <hex:021A020203>slow<hex:021A020103>.<hex:02100103>And I thought I could protect you...

56.original: You can't blame yourself for things beyond your control. You brought Halric back safe and sound─no one could have done any more.

57.original: I'm sorry, but I've come to a decision: I won't be continuing in my role here.

58.original: I hope you will forgive me for leaving you...and that you will delay Halric's last meal for as long as you possibly can.

59.original: Not until it's too late, of course, just...give him what time you can.

61.original: Of course. She would have done the same.

62.original: Farewell, Halric. Keep Tesleen's words close to your heart.

63.original: Wait! You're leaving this very moment? I understand how you must feel, but surely this is a bit hasty? Do you even have anywhere to go?

64.original: I have a destination in mind, yes. And a purpose.

65.original: This damned Light, building without cease... It's the reason we can't save those corrupted by the eaters.

66.original: But what if we corrected the balance? Even if it were only little by little─even if it took <hex:021A020203>years<hex:021A020103>─it would surely make things better.

67.original: Now, hold on there. Everyone knows there's too much Light, but how could you ever hope to get rid of it? You'd have to change the whole world!

69.original: We should return to the Crystarium. I may not be able to repel the eaters on my own...but I can still use the skills I have gained here to hurt them.

70.original: Poor Alisaie... She was so close to Tesleen... I only hope she doesn't do something foolish.

71.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Good to see you again! You look like you've a story or two to tell... But I sense you'd sooner get back to the Crystarium.

72.original: Forgive me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─I couldn't stay there a moment longer.

73.original: But I was serious about what I said. While the men and women at the Inn battle against this blight with kindness, I must fight it in my own way. With steel.

75.original: From Eorzea's sword in the darkness...to Norvrandt's sword in the light?

77.original: Gods above. It feels like an age ago now...

78.original: Miss Alisaie!? ...Is there anything I can get you?

79.original: Your swiftest amaro! I need to return to the Crystarium─immediately!

81.original: Ah, it's good to be back. Mord Souq has many charms, but there's nothing like a proper bed to recover from a long journey...as I'm sure you'd agree.

82.original: Ugh, remind me to wear goggles if we ever fly over Amh Araeng again. I've barely gotten the sand out of my eyes.

83.original: ...But the wind did help to clear my head at least.

84.original: I think I'm ready to meet with the Exarch. We need to talk about how we're going to wipe the sin eaters out. Shall we?

85.original: I see you were reunited with Alisaie, but I daresay you found little else to celebrate in Amh Araeng...

86.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You will have to share the tale of your journey once the two of you are suitably rested.

87.original: Thank you for seeking me out, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─it meant a lot to have you there at my side.<hex:02100103>...I was tempted to set off again the moment we had decided upon a direction, but you have still to visit Alphinaud, haven't you?

88.original: And if I know my brother, he'll be on the cusp of discovering something vital to our success─if he hasn't already. I'm content to stay here and consider our options for the time being─but don't keep me waiting too long, eh?

89.original: Thank you for seeking me out, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─it meant a lot to have you there at my side. And looking at Alphinaud, I'd say he's as eager to begin this discussion as I am.

90.original: I say we lay our experiences before the Exarch, and step back to see what kind of picture they make. Then we can decide where to go from here.
